name: signal transducer and activator of transcription 3

function.text: STAT3 encodes signal transducer and activator of transcription 3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to STAT3-related early-onset multisystem autoimmune disease (autosomal dominant); hyper-IgE recurrent infection syndrome 1, autosomal dominant (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Mycosis fungoides; Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma; Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
